meta.bit_reading_note: every circuit has six classical bits. In the wait test (circuit W-no, W-ref; part W) c0 to c4 are the end lines' results (manacitra.wait.WAIT_TEST_ROUNDS) and c5 is M's; in the Ramsey circuits and the zero-wait baseline (part R) only M is measured, into c5 (the label's m_clbit), and the other bits read 0
meta.description: Kickoff 51, a known offset. Two waiting qubits M: 144 on 143-144-145, and 143 on 144-143-142. A known phase phi in {-90, 0, +90} degrees, one rz(phi) on M right after its first H. Per M and phi: W-no(phi), the wait test without refocusing with rz(phi) inserted; R0(phi), a plain Ramsey over T_M with the neighbours idle; R1(phi), the wait test with every CZ touching M replaced by a delay of the same length (the neighbours active, as in W-no); R2(phi), R0 with both neighbours in |1>. Per M at phi = 0: W-ref (XY4) and Z. 56 circuits, each 2 copies of 5000 shots, in one random order; the sampler's own dynamical decoupling and twirling off, as IBM recorded them.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0

built_from.how: W-no(phi) by manacitra.wait.build_wait_test at this commit, unedited, with rz(phi) inserted on M (hw_51.py, insert_phase); W-ref by build_wait_test, unedited; R1(phi) by hw_50.py's cz_to_delays on W-no(phi) as scheduled; R0(phi), R2(phi) and Z written on the wait test's three lines, translated by manacitra.wait.to_backend and scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled; against the live ibm_fez target at build

T_M.definition: from the end of M's first H (its first sx) to the start of its last H (its last sx), in the wait test without refocusing (W-no) as scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled on the live target

fixed_before_the_data.rule: H51: SUPPORTED if the swing A = [d(+90) - d(-90)] / 2, d(phi) = F_no(phi) - F_ref (1 - loss_R0(phi)), has its interval entirely outside [-supported_outside, +supported_outside] on at least one of the two qubits; NOT SUPPORTED if entirely inside [-not_supported_inside, +not_supported_inside] on both; NOT SETTLED otherwise. F against the wait test's phi = 0 parity ideal
fixed_before_the_data.bootstraps: 90% intervals (5th and 95th percentiles) from one joint bootstrap (seed bootstrap, n_boot draws), in a fixed order: M by M (144, then 143): F for W-no at -90, 0, +90 and W-ref, then P(1) for Z and R0, R1, R2 each at -90, 0, +90; for each, the wait test's F (the copies with replacement, each redrawn from a multinomial), then M's P(1) (the copies with replacement, each redrawn binomially)

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "site"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import manacitra  # noqa: E402
from manacitra import wait as W  # noqa: E402
import hw_50 as K50  # noqa: E402  Kickoff 50's transformations, unchanged

COMMIT, TAG_NAME = "a55354d0d4903d5d624c6cf946b8130d0ccc4b57", "v0.5.0"
K49_SHA = K50.K49_SHA
HW50_SHA = "f6ed4e35ff8f03554586e81ddd06582f6d219f4a33b0c4dbe6773747b4e578ef"   # hardware-50/inputs.json
RULE_SHA_GIVEN = None                                                             # set from the author's message in chat
CHAINS = {"144": [143, 144, 145], "143": [144, 143, 142]}
PHIS = (-90, 0, 90)
COPIES, SHOTS = 2, 5_000
SEEDS = {"order": 5151, "bootstrap": 51, "n_boot": 10_000}
M_CLBIT = W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS - 1
T_M_K50 = 2611
CAL_K50 = "2026-10-13 17:32:21 UTC"


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


now = K50.now


def log(msg):
    line = f"{now()} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with (HERE / "run.log").open("a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def cell_items():
    """The 56 circuits in their listed order: (M, circuit, phi, copy)."""
    out = []
    for n in CHAINS:
        kinds = [("W-no", p) for p in PHIS] + [("W-ref", 0)] + [(k, p) for k in ("R0", "R1", "R2") for p in PHIS] + [("Z", 0)]
        out += [(n, k, p, cp) for k, p in kinds for cp in range(1, COPIES + 1)]
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the phase and the circuits
def insert_phase(ins, M, phi_deg):
    """rz(phi) on M right after the last rz of M's first H (rz, sx, rz)."""
    from qiskit.circuit.library import RZGate
    on_m = [k for k, (op, qs, _) in enumerate(ins) if qs == [M]]
    names = [ins[k][0].name for k in on_m]
    i = names.index("sx")
    if names[i - 1] != "rz" or names[i + 1] != "rz":
        raise RuntimeError("M's first H is not rz, sx, rz")
    k = on_m[i + 1]
    return ins[:k + 1] + [(RZGate(math.radians(phi_deg)), [M], [])] + ins[k + 1:]


def logical(kind, T, phi_deg):
    """R0 or R2 with rz(phi) on M right after its first H, on the wait test's three lines (M into c5)."""
    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3, W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS, name=f"{kind}{phi_deg:+d}")
    if kind == "R2":
        qc.x(W.L1)
        qc.x(W.L3)
        qc.barrier()
    qc.h(W.M)
    qc.rz(math.radians(phi_deg), W.M)
    qc.delay(T, W.M, unit="dt")
    qc.h(W.M)
    qc.measure(W.M, M_CLBIT)
    return qc


def build_chain(name, chain, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    no = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend)
    ref = W.build_wait_test(chain, True, backend)
    no0_ins, _ = K50.schedule(no, backend, chain)
    tl0 = K50.timed(no0_ins, t, dt, chain)
    T = K50.window(tl0, M)["T_dt"]
    z_ins, z_isa = _made(K50.logical("Z", T), chain, backend)
    circ = {("W-ref", 0): ref, ("Z", 0): K50.rebuild(z_isa, z_ins, f"Z-{name}")}
    for phi in PHIS:
        wno = K50.rebuild(no, insert_phase(K50.instructions(no), M, phi), f"W-no{phi:+d}-{name}")
        circ[("W-no", phi)] = wno
        w_ins, _ = K50.schedule(wno, backend, chain)
        circ[("R1", phi)] = K50.rebuild(no, K50.cz_to_delays(w_ins, M, t, dt), f"R1{phi:+d}-{name}")
        for kind in ("R0", "R2"):
            ins, isa = _made(logical(kind, T, phi), chain, backend)
            circ[(kind, phi)] = K50.rebuild(isa, ins, f"{kind}{phi:+d}-{name}")
    return circ, {"T_M": K50.window(tl0, M), "tl_no": tl0}


def _made(qc, chain, backend):
    isa = W.to_backend(qc, chain, backend)
    return K50.schedule(isa, backend, chain)[0], isa


def m_sequence(c, M):
    """M's instructions in order, delays left out: (name, an rz's angle in degrees, else None)."""
    out = []
    for i in c.data:
        nm = i.operation.name
        if nm == "delay" or M not in [c.find_bit(q).index for q in i.qubits]:
            continue
        out.append((nm, round(math.degrees(float(i.operation.params[0])), 6) if nm == "rz" else None))
    return out


def checks(name, chain, circ, info, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    T = info["T_M"]["T_dt"]
    rec, tls = {}, {}
    for (k, phi), c in circ.items():
        key = f"{k}|{phi:+d}"
        ins, _ = K50.schedule(c, backend, chain)
        tl = K50.timed(ins, t, dt, chain)
        tls[(k, phi)] = tl
        ops = {a: int(b) for a, b in c.count_ops().items()}
        init = list(c.layout.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True))
        p = W.exact_distribution(c)
        r = {"count_ops": ops, "no_swap": ops.get("swap", 0) == 0, "layout_as_named": init == chain,
             "non_delay_ops_only_on_chain": {c.find_bit(q).index for i in c.data if i.operation.name != "delay" for q in i.qubits} <= set(chain)}
        seq = m_sequence(c, M)
        if k.startswith("W"):
            r["exact_F"] = W.fidelity(p, ideal)
            r["exact_F_expected"] = 1.0 if phi == 0 else 0.5
            r["exact_F_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_F"] - r["exact_F_expected"]) < 1e-6
            r["structure_5cz_6meas_3reset"] = ops.get("cz") == 5 and ops.get("measure") == 6 and ops.get("reset") == 3
        else:
            r["exact_P1_M"] = sum(v for kk, v in p.items() if kk[0] == "1")
            r["exact_P1_expected"] = 0.0 if phi == 0 else 0.5
            r["exact_P1_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_P1_M"] - r["exact_P1_expected"]) < 1e-9
            w = K50.window(tl, M)
            r["M_window"] = w
            r["window_ok"] = (w["T_dt"] == T if k != "Z" else w["T_dt"] == 0) and w["n_sx"] == 2
        if k != "W-ref" and k != "Z":
            # the phase: one rz(phi) on M, right after the first H (rz 90, sx, rz 90), inside M's window in time
            i = [n for n, _ in seq].index("sx")
            r["M_first_H_then_phase"] = seq[i - 1:i + 3]
            r["phase_right_after_first_H"] = seq[i - 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 2] == ("rz", float(phi))
            rz_t = [s for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if nm == "rz" and qs == [M]]
            w = K50.window(tl, M)
            r["phase_time_dt"] = rz_t[2]
            r["phase_inside_window"] = w["start_dt"] <= rz_t[2] <= w["end_dt"]
        if k == "W-no":
            j0 = [n for n, _ in seq].index("sx")
            j1 = len(seq) - 1 - [n for n, _ in seq][::-1].index("sx")
            between = seq[j0 + 1:j1]
            inner = between[2:-1]                      # past the first H's rz and the phase; before the last H's rz
            r["M_ops_between_H"] = [n for n, _ in between]
            r["check3_cz_barrier_and_phase_only"] = {n for n, _ in inner} <= {"cz", "barrier"} and [n for n, _ in inner].count("cz") == 5
        if k == "W-ref":
            r["pulses_on_M"] = K50.x_on(c, M) > K50.x_on(circ[("W-no", 0)], M)
        rec[key] = r
    tab = {str(q): {"W-no unedited": K50.events(info["tl_no"], q), **{f"{k}|{phi:+d}": K50.events(tls[(k, phi)], q) for k in ("W-no", "R1") for phi in PHIS}} for q in (L1, L3)}
    same = all(v == tab[str(q)]["W-no unedited"] for q in (L1, L3) for v in tab[str(q)].values())
    rec["_neighbours"] = {"measure_reset_times": tab, "R1_and_W_no_same_as_W_no0": same}
    flat = [v for kk, r in rec.items() if not kk.startswith("_") for v in r.values() if isinstance(v, bool)]
    return rec, all(flat) and same


def build(backend):
    circ, recs, infos, ok = {}, {}, {}, True
    for name, chain in CHAINS.items():
        c, info = build_chain(name, chain, backend)
        r, good = checks(name, chain, c, info, backend)
        ok = ok and good
        circ[name], recs[name], infos[name] = c, r, {"T_M": info["T_M"]}
    return circ, recs, infos, ok


def assemble(circ, seed=SEEDS["order"]):
    items = cell_items()
    perm = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(items))
    circs, labels = [], []
    for i in perm:
        n, k, phi, cp = items[i]
        lab = {"M": int(n), "chain": CHAINS[n], "circuit": k, "phi_deg": phi, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": M_CLBIT,
               "part": "W" if k.startswith("W") else "R"}
        circs.append(circ[n][(k, phi)])
        labels.append(lab)
    return circs, labels, [SHOTS] * len(circs)

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "site"))
import manacitra  # noqa: E402
from manacitra import wait as W  # noqa: E402

COMMIT, TAG_NAME = "a55354d0d4903d5d624c6cf946b8130d0ccc4b57", "v0.5.0"
K49_SHA = {"wait.py": "ead255a4be1d0e1ae9cffbc6d266cc70fe9a6534c685bd18e2772a1f7b69a2a8",
           "workload.py": "ad24c80ca4f6cba7f19940dd15c6cc5ec9d18ebfeba503eff225d57cd52dd02b"}   # hardware-49/inputs.json
RULE_SHA_GIVEN = "8a3228b03e89fca5a81e101f59d9d65757a74a6c06f2b0205f158770b85da039"   # the author, in chat, 13 October
CHAINS = {"144": [143, 144, 145], "143": [144, 143, 142]}
CIRCUITS = ("W-no", "W-ref", "R0", "R1", "R2", "R3", "E0", "E1", "Z")
COPIES, SHOTS = 2, 5_000
SEEDS = {"order": 5050, "bootstrap": 50, "n_boot": 10_000}
M_CLBIT = W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS - 1        # M is measured into c5 in every circuit
T_M_K49 = {"scheduled_dt": 2611, "part_b_even_dt": 2612}
CAL_K49 = "2026-10-13 16:08:33 UTC"


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def now():
    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())


def log(msg):
    line = f"{now()} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with (HERE / "run.log").open("a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- instructions and timelines
def instructions(c):
    """A circuit as a list of (operation, physical qubits, clbits)."""
    return [(i.operation, [c.find_bit(q).index for q in i.qubits], [c.find_bit(x).index for x in i.clbits]) for i in c.data]


def rebuild(src, ins, name):
    """A circuit with src's qubits, clbits, registers and layout record, holding these instructions."""
    out = src.copy_empty_like(name=name)
    for op, qs, cs in ins:
        out.append(op, [out.qubits[i] for i in qs], [out.clbits[j] for j in cs])
    out._layout = src.layout
    return out


def duration(op, qs, target, dt):
    nm = op.name
    if nm == "delay":
        if op.unit != "dt":
            raise RuntimeError(f"a delay in {op.unit}, not dt")
        return int(op.duration)
    if nm in ("barrier", "rz"):
        return 0
    return int(round(target[nm][tuple(qs)].duration / dt))


def timed(ins, target, dt, qubits):
    """Start times of a padded instruction list on these qubits: each qubit's instructions tile time, and every
    multi-qubit instruction (CZ, barrier) starts when all its qubits are free at the same moment. Refuses a list that
    is not padded. Returns [(index, name, qubits, clbits, start, duration)] for instructions on these qubits."""
    clock = defaultdict(int)
    out = []
    for k, (op, qs, cs) in enumerate(ins):
        if not set(qs) & set(qubits):
            continue
        d = duration(op, qs, target, dt)
        starts = {clock[q] for q in qs}
        if len(starts) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(f"not padded at {op.name} on {qs}: clocks {sorted(starts)}")
        s = starts.pop()
        for q in qs:
            clock[q] = s + d
        out.append((k, op.name, qs, cs, s, d))
    return out


def schedule(c, backend, chain):
    """manacitra.wait.scheduled, keeping only the chain's instructions."""
    sch = W.scheduled(c, backend.target)
    return [x for x in instructions(sch) if set(x[1]) <= set(chain)], sch


def window(tl, M):
    """M's window: the end of its first sx to the start of its last sx."""
    sx = [(s, d) for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if nm == "sx" and qs == [M]]
    return {"start_dt": sx[0][0] + sx[0][1], "end_dt": sx[-1][0], "T_dt": sx[-1][0] - (sx[0][0] + sx[0][1]), "n_sx": len(sx)}


def events(tl, q, names=("measure", "reset")):
    return [{"op": nm, "start_dt": s, "duration_dt": d, "clbit": (cs[0] if cs else None)} for _, nm, qs, cs, s, d in tl if q in qs and nm in names]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the transformations
def cz_to_delays(ins, M, target, dt):
    from qiskit.circuit import Delay
    out = []
    for op, qs, cs in ins:
        if op.name == "cz" and M in qs:
            d = duration(op, qs, target, dt)
            out += [(Delay(d, unit="dt"), [q], []) for q in qs]
        else:
            out.append((op, qs, cs))
    return out


def neighbours_quiet(ins, ends, target, dt):
    from qiskit.circuit import Delay
    out = []
    for op, qs, cs in ins:
        if len(qs) == 1 and qs[0] in ends and op.name not in ("measure", "reset", "delay", "barrier"):
            if op.name not in ("rz", "sx", "x"):
                raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected {op.name} on a neighbour")
            d = duration(op, qs, target, dt)
            if d:
                out.append((Delay(d, unit="dt"), qs, []))
        else:
            out.append((op, qs, cs))
    return out


def insert_echo(ins, M, target, dt, chain):
    """One X on M at the middle of M's window, splitting the delay on M that holds it."""
    from qiskit.circuit import Delay
    from qiskit.circuit.library import XGate
    tl = timed(ins, target, dt, chain)
    w = window(tl, M)
    dx = int(round(target["x"][(M,)].duration / dt))
    p = w["start_dt"] + (w["T_dt"] - dx) // 2
    hold = [(k, s, d) for k, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if nm == "delay" and qs == [M] and s <= p and p + dx <= s + d]
    if len(hold) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("no single delay on M holds the window's middle")
    k, s, d = hold[0]
    new = [(Delay(p - s, unit="dt"), [M], [])] if p > s else []
    new.append((XGate(), [M], []))
    if s + d - p - dx > 0:
        new.append((Delay(s + d - p - dx, unit="dt"), [M], []))
    out = ins[:k] + new + ins[k + 1:]
    return out, {"x_start_dt": p, "x_duration_dt": dx, "centre_offset_dt": (p + dx / 2) - (w["start_dt"] + w["T_dt"] / 2)}


def logical(kind, T):
    """R0, R2 or Z on the wait test's three lines (L1 = 0, M = 1, L3 = 2), M measured into c5."""
    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3, W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS, name=kind)
    if kind == "R2":
        qc.x(W.L1)
        qc.x(W.L3)
        qc.barrier()
    qc.h(W.M)
    if kind in ("R0", "R2"):
        qc.delay(T, W.M, unit="dt")
    qc.h(W.M)
    qc.measure(W.M, M_CLBIT)
    return qc


def build_chain(name, chain, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    no = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend)
    ref = W.build_wait_test(chain, True, backend)
    no_ins, _ = schedule(no, backend, chain)
    tl_no = timed(no_ins, t, dt, chain)
    w_no = window(tl_no, M)
    T = w_no["T_dt"]
    # check 3: in W-no, M's instructions between its first and last H (rz, sx, rz each) are CZs (and barriers) only
    m_ops = [nm for op, qs, _ in instructions(no) if M in qs for nm in [op.name]]
    i0, i1 = m_ops.index("sx"), len(m_ops) - 1 - m_ops[::-1].index("sx")
    between = m_ops[i0 + 1:i1]
    inner = between[1:-1] if between[:1] == ["rz"] and between[-1:] == ["rz"] else between
    check3 = {"M_ops_between_first_and_last_sx": between, "cz_only": set(inner) <= {"cz", "barrier"} and inner.count("cz") == 5}
    r1_ins = cz_to_delays(no_ins, M, t, dt)
    r3_ins = neighbours_quiet(r1_ins, (L1, L3), t, dt)
    e1_ins, e1_x = insert_echo(r1_ins, M, t, dt, chain)
    made = {}
    for kind in ("R0", "R2", "Z"):
        isa = W.to_backend(logical(kind, T), chain, backend)
        made[kind] = schedule(isa, backend, chain)[0], isa
    e0_ins, e0_x = insert_echo(made["R0"][0], M, t, dt, chain)
    circ = {"W-no": no, "W-ref": ref,
            "R0": rebuild(made["R0"][1], made["R0"][0], f"R0-{name}"), "R1": rebuild(no, r1_ins, f"R1-{name}"),
            "R2": rebuild(made["R2"][1], made["R2"][0], f"R2-{name}"), "R3": rebuild(no, r3_ins, f"R3-{name}"),
            "E0": rebuild(made["R0"][1], e0_ins, f"E0-{name}"), "E1": rebuild(no, e1_ins, f"E1-{name}"),
            "Z": rebuild(made["Z"][1], made["Z"][0], f"Z-{name}")}
    return circ, {"T_M": w_no, "check3": check3, "echo_x": {"E0": e0_x, "E1": e1_x}, "tl_no": tl_no}


def x_on(c, q):
    return sum(1 for i in c.data if i.operation.name == "x" and c.find_bit(i.qubits[0]).index == q)


def checks(name, chain, circ, info, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    T = info["T_M"]["T_dt"]
    rec = {}
    tls = {}
    for k, c in circ.items():
        ins, _ = schedule(c, backend, chain)
        tl = timed(ins, t, dt, chain)
        tls[k] = tl
        ops = {a: int(b) for a, b in c.count_ops().items()}
        init = list(c.layout.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True))
        p = W.exact_distribution(c)
        r = {"count_ops": ops, "no_swap": ops.get("swap", 0) == 0, "layout_as_named": init == chain,
             "non_delay_ops_only_on_chain": {c.find_bit(q).index for i in c.data if i.operation.name != "delay" for q in i.qubits} <= set(chain)}
        if k.startswith("W"):
            r["exact_F"] = W.fidelity(p, ideal)
            r["exact_F_1"] = abs(r["exact_F"] - 1) < 1e-6
            r["structure_5cz_6meas_3reset"] = ops.get("cz") == 5 and ops.get("measure") == 6 and ops.get("reset") == 3
        else:
            r["exact_P1_M"] = sum(v for key, v in p.items() if key[0] == "1")
            r["M_reads_0"] = r["exact_P1_M"] < 1e-9
            if k != "Z":
                w = window(tl, M)
                r["M_window"] = w
                r["window_is_T_M"] = w["T_dt"] == T and w["n_sx"] == 2
            else:
                r["M_window"] = window(tl, M)
                r["zero_wait"] = r["M_window"]["T_dt"] == 0
            m_between = [nm for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if M in qs and r["M_window"]["start_dt"] <= s < r["M_window"]["end_dt"] and nm not in ("rz",)]
            r["M_ops_in_window"] = sorted(set(m_between))
            r["M_window_ops_ok"] = set(m_between) <= ({"delay", "barrier", "x"} if k.startswith("E") else {"delay", "barrier"}) and (m_between.count("x") == (1 if k.startswith("E") else 0))
        if k == "W-ref":
            r["pulses_on_M"] = x_on(c, M) > x_on(circ["W-no"], M)
        rec[k] = r
    # check 2: in R1 and R3 every measure and reset on L1 and L3 starts and lasts as in W-no, to the dt
    tab = {str(q): {"W-no": events(info["tl_no"], q), "R1": events(tls["R1"], q), "R3": events(tls["R3"], q), "E1": events(tls["E1"], q)} for q in (L1, L3)}
    same = all(tab[str(q)][k] == tab[str(q)]["W-no"] for q in (L1, L3) for k in ("R1", "R3", "E1"))
    # R1's neighbours: every operation other than a delay or barrier at the same start and length as in W-no, the CZs
    # with M gone (they are idle time now; re-scheduling may join adjacent delays, which changes no start time)
    keep = lambda tl, q: [(nm, s, d) for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if q in qs and nm not in ("barrier", "delay", "cz")]
    r1_same = all(keep(info["tl_no"], q) == keep(tls["R1"], q) for q in (L1, L3))
    m_r2 = window(tls["R2"], M)
    x_r2 = [(s, d) for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tls["R2"] if nm == "x" and qs[0] in (L1, L3)]
    rec["_neighbours"] = {"measure_reset_times": tab, "R1_R3_E1_same_as_W_no": same, "R1_neighbour_timeline_same_as_W_no": r1_same,
                          "R2_x_before_M_first_H": all(s + d <= m_r2["start_dt"] for s, d in x_r2) and len(x_r2) == 2,
                          "R3_neighbours_only_measure_reset_delay_barrier": all(nm in ("measure", "reset", "delay", "barrier") for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tls["R3"] if qs == [L1] or qs == [L3])}
    rec["_check3"] = info["check3"]
    rec["_echo_x"] = info["echo_x"]
    ok = (all(all(v for kk, v in r.items() if isinstance(v, bool)) for kk_, r in rec.items() if not kk_.startswith("_"))
          and same and r1_same and rec["_neighbours"]["R2_x_before_M_first_H"] and rec["_neighbours"]["R3_neighbours_only_measure_reset_delay_barrier"]
          and info["check3"]["cz_only"])
    return rec, ok


def build(backend):
    circ, recs, infos, ok = {}, {}, {}, True
    for name, chain in CHAINS.items():
        c, info = build_chain(name, chain, backend)
        r, good = checks(name, chain, c, info, backend)
        ok = ok and good
        circ[name] = c
        recs[name] = r
        infos[name] = {"T_M": info["T_M"], "check3": info["check3"], "echo_x": info["echo_x"]}
    return circ, recs, infos, ok


def assemble(circ, seed=SEEDS["order"]):
    items = [(n, k, cp) for n in CHAINS for k in CIRCUITS for cp in range(1, COPIES + 1)]
    perm = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(items))
    circs, labels = [], []
    for i in perm:
        n, k, cp = items[i]
        lab = {"M": int(n), "chain": CHAINS[n], "circuit": k, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": M_CLBIT}
        if k.startswith("W"):
            lab.update({"part": "W", "variant": "no" if k == "W-no" else "refocus"})
        else:
            lab["part"] = "R"
        circs.append(circ[n][k])
        labels.append(lab)
    return circs, labels, [SHOTS] * len(circs)
